name: EA Visual Compiler
costPolicy: Open-source/self-hosted only. No new paid SaaS or account required.

certificates.visual: Reference comparison must pass configured visual threshold at every certified viewport.
certificates.functional: Every visible interactive control must have a tested destination or behavior.
certificates.integration: Website to authentication to portal and required data/module flows must pass end-to-end.

certificationRule: VISUAL + FUNCTIONAL + INTEGRATION are all required. A screenshot overlay or image hotspot implementation cannot satisfy FUNCTIONAL certification.
mobileRule: Never invent an alternate mobile composition. Reconstruct responsive behavior from the approved reference set; where only one reference exists, preserve composition and require human approval for inferred responsive changes.
